Describing the 'Confidence' line as simply increasing ('steigt') from the start to the end value is an over-generalization. It omits the description of a peak at popularity 10, a subsequent dip around popularity 14, and then a final rise.
The description states the 'Alignment' line fluctuates starting from approximately 0.48. The actual minimum value on the chart, at a popularity of 5, is approximately 0.45.
